name: omnisense/omnisong
description: Omnisong: one contract for listening to a musician's catalogue - releases, tracks, previews, the links to every platform with the label first, and the embeds that play from them - and its Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnisong/odesli: Odesli (song.link): the same song or album on every platform, by a URL or a platform's id
suggest.omnisong/itunes: The iTunes Search API: releases, their tracks and 30-second previews, an artist's albums - no key
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnisong\Bridge\Symfony\OmnisongBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnisong\Bridge\Symfony\OmnisongBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnisong\Bridge\Symfony\OmnisongBundle itself
suggest.twig/twig: With Twig: Omnisong\Bridge\Twig\OmnisongExtension, the players and the platforms' names in the templates
